Select IC50 activity rows for JAK2 with publication provenance. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target name JAK2. LEFT JOIN docs on assays.doc_id to get pubmed_id and doi. LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno to get canonical_smiles. LEFT JOIN compound_records on activities.record_id to get compound_key. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
